research_question: Can an evaluator-owned UI-only adapter reproduce the official API ui payload exactly at the same fixed states while eliminating vision encoding and frame-file side effects?
lifecycle: stdlib-only launcher reads each approved controller byte once with O_NOFOLLOW, verifies SHA-256, fsyncs a private seal, then execs sealed bootstrap with -I -S -B; run/lifecycle/protocol imports resolve only from that seal

before marker, the controller verifies/copies an exact 7,136-entry CPython+site-packages content manifest, a clean pinned source git archive, and all authority bytes; worker executes only relocated copies
race-free SIGINT/SIGTERM/SIGHUP latch is installed before marker. Signals before the blocked outcome-commit barrier dominate non-PASS; later signals are deferred until committed publication completes

absolute monotonic launch_and_execution deadline is checked before PLANNED, after identity, before setup, immediately before/after Popen, and in bounded wait; a planned expired cell finishes global_deadline without a new spawn
sandbox allows only initial process exec and denies fork/spawn, network, and external writes. The fixed worker is one session/PGID leader; containment/unreaped status is sticky
stdout/stderr/events/UI use controller-created inherited FDs and device/inode-checked O_NOFOLLOW copy; frames use a retained directory FD and no-follow openat-style enumeration

all claimed success/failure sidecars are rehashed; every PLANNED cell must FINISH; valid cells/pairs are recomputed; pending result canonical bytes/status/previous hash are mutually bound to FINALIZED and the published inode
marker is never removed; handled logical failures publish non-PASS when storage permits; SIGKILL/power loss/ENOSPC may leave an explicit consumed-unclosed state and never authorize retry or PASS

fixed_scope.controlled_frame_directory: unique per cell; measure before cleanup

primary: 20/20 official-to-ui_only ordered canonical UI hash vectors are exact at observations 0-1000
10/10 UI-only same-seed repeat ordered UI hash vectors are exact
all 30 cells are valid_complete with exact manifest identity, exit 0, counters 1..1001, 1000 successful action/tick transitions and pinned source identities
source-mirrored UI side-effect fingerprints match official mode for the allowlisted state fields
official cells produce exactly 1002 PNG files in isolated temporary directories; UI-only cells produce zero
secondary: official frame bytes per cell before cleanup
message queue 0/1/2 and dialog sentinel fixture results

falsifiers: any official-to-ui_only ordered UI hash vector mismatch
any invalid, timeout, crash, malformed or unobservable cell
any allowlisted post-observation state fingerprint mismatch
any UI-only frame or vision key
scope_limits: a PASS admits source-mirrored adapter only for the pinned fixed ROTATE_DIRECTION/tick public-UI projection across two named families/seeds 0-4
it does not establish arbitrary action, dialog, inventory-changing, task-solving, visual, scorer, gold or full internal-state equivalence
official mode generates vision/frame artifacts; UI-only mode omits them
Python socket denial is defense-in-depth, not OS isolation
families n=2; 30 cells and 30 mode/repeat comparisons are nested technical evidence
no task outcome, TREE/TYPED behavior, model or ARGO efficacy

execution_policy.cleanly_reaped_cell_invalid: continue frozen manifest and mark pair unobservable

budgets.deadline_scope: 5520 seconds is a launch_and_execution deadline, not a bound on kernel Popen latency or mandatory fsync closure. No Popen is called after a fresh expired pre-call sample.

approval.note: proposal intentionally does not hash approval to preserve acyclic binding; approval must hash this proposal

stopping_rule: one approved 30-cell run; completed parity mismatch is scientific FAIL; invalid/timeout/drift/unreaped/write-error is INVALID or INCOMPLETE; no retry/resume/repair

environment.provenance_limitation: Worker CPython prefix and site-package bytes are exact-content manifested, copied, and pre/final verified. macOS kernel, dyld shared cache, system frameworks, sandbox-exec, and the controller interpreter runtime are the host TCB.

result_contract.atomic_publication: full canonical payload fsynced at bound result_temp_path, then ledger finalized/validated, then exclusive hard-link to result_path and parent directory fsync; no direct final-path writes

strong_closure: every claimed sidecar is path-bound and rehashed for all terminal statuses; every planned cell is terminal; valid cells and 30 pairs are recomputed; canonical pending result is mutually bound to finalized ledger and published inode

timing: immediately after returned UI and api.taskProgress/api.steps update
state_snapshot_contract.canonicalization: UTF-8 JSON, ensure_ascii=false, sorted keys, separators comma/colon, allow_nan=false, SHA-256
state_snapshot_contract.expected_counters: observation i=0..1000: pre api_steps=i and world_counter=i+1; post api_steps=world_counter=i+1; controlled world delta 1000
state_snapshot_contract.snapshot_ownership: deep-copied immutable snapshot; later observation mutation cannot rewrite pre-state
